imageNotes: Nine usable native public stills form eight distinct garment looks. Images01,06,07 are black Reel covers with a small CapCut logo and are excluded. Images03/04 form one red outer-layer product. Displayed styling descriptions do not imply that multiple garments are sold as a bundle. Do not infer textile composition, prices, exact sizes or stock.
designRecommendation: Use rich burgundy and charcoal type on clean white, large uncluttered native photographs and a concise boutique story. Instagram enquiry is the verified public contact channel; keep phone and WhatsApp absent unless a real public number is supplied. Avoid the black Reel covers01/06/07.
commercialFit: An image-led searchable collection with saved favourites and item-specific enquiries can help customers browse beyond the Instagram feed. Current sizes, stock and prices should be confirmed by the boutique; do not invent checkout, payment or fulfilment capability.
researchStatus: Complete: eight looks and nine native public images selected after visual QA.
